note: Fees change often. Figures marked verified were checked against public fee breakdowns dated Oct–Nov 2026; always confirm on the platform before listing.

items.name: eBay
items.protection: Money Back Guarantee on most items
items.feeText: About 13.6% of total + $0.40 per order (most categories)
items.bestFor: Widest buyer reach, collectibles, parts, electronics, anything niche

items.name: Facebook Marketplace (local pickup)
items.bestFor: Bulky, heavy or low-value items where shipping kills margin

items.name: Facebook Marketplace (shipped)
items.protection: Purchase Protection on eligible checkout orders
items.bestFor: Shippable everyday goods to a huge audience

items.name: Mercari
items.protection: Buyer protection and Authenticate for eligible items
items.bestFor: Casual sellers shipping small items under a few hundred dollars

items.name: Poshmark
items.protection: Posh Protect; payment held until delivery
items.bestFor: Brand-name clothing and accessories with a social following

items.name: Depop
items.protection: Purchase protection when paid through Depop Payments
items.feeText: 0% seller commission (US/UK) + 3.3% + $0.45 processing; optional Boost fee
items.bestFor: Vintage, Y2K, streetwear and trend-led fashion

items.name: Vinted
items.protection: Buyer Protection (paid by buyer); seller paid after buyer confirms
items.feeText: 0% for sellers; buyer pays a Buyer Protection fee
items.bestFor: Everyday clothing and kids' items at volume

items.name: Etsy (vintage 20+ years)
items.bestFor: True vintage (20+ years) décor, jewelry and clothing

items.name: Whatnot (live auctions)
items.bestFor: Cards, collectibles and fashion sold live to an audience

items.name: Grailed
items.protection: Purchase protection; listing authentication on high-risk brands
items.feeText: 9% commission on the total sale + payment processing (approx. 3.49% + $0.49 US)
items.bestFor: Designer menswear, streetwear and archive pieces

items.name: Swappa
items.bestFor: Working phones, tablets, laptops and consoles

items.name: Reverb
items.feeText: About 5% selling fee + payment processing (approx. 3.19% + $0.49 US)
items.bestFor: Guitars, amps, pedals, synths, pro audio; has its own price guide

items.name: OfferUp
items.protection: Safe meetup spot suggestions; no fee on local deals
items.feeText: No fee on local deals; optional paid promotion
items.bestFor: Local furniture, tools, appliances and vehicles

items.name: Craigslist
items.protection: None — advice is to deal locally, face-to-face
items.feeText: Free in most for-sale categories (small fees in a few)
items.bestFor: Simple local sales; free stuff; older audiences

items.name: Kijiji
items.feeText: Free basic ads; paid upgrades and some paid categories

items.name: Nextdoor For Sale & Free
items.bestFor: Selling or giving away to verified neighbours

items.name: OLX India

items.name: Wallapop
